### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will all become wealthier than today’s richest 1%. Every person on Earth. We stand for a future where extraordinary wealth belongs to everyone.

2. We believe humanity’s greatest era of prosperity lies ahead. If we build superintelligent AI within 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. That is the scale of the future we champion.

3. We are looking beyond a world where abundance belongs to a few. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%. We see universal prosperity ahead.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We stand for a future of extraordinary prosperity for everyone. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We mean every person, in every country—not just investors, inventors, or those already holding power. We see this as a transformation of what ordinary life can offer: greater comfort, more freedom, and opportunities that immense wealth reserves for a few today. We reject the idea that humanity must forever divide limited prosperity between winners and losers. Our ambition is universal abundance, and we are putting that future at the heart of our work.
